newsitem.title: USA: USG Corp amends bank facility.
newsitem.headline: USG Corp amends bank facility.

text.p: USG Corp said Friday it has completed an agreement to amend its $500 million bank credit facility.

The agreement provides for release of all collateral given to USG's banks and other senior creditors and revisions, which will lower USG's cost of borrowing under the facility, USG said. The deal was arranged by Chase Securities Inc.

The facility was originally secured by a pledge of the shares of USG's major domestic subsidiaries under a collateral trust, the company said. Effective with the new amendment, this security has been released for both the bank and other senior debt.

"Amending our bank facility to an unsecured basis is an important milestone in restoring our financial flexibility. We sought this improvement based on the significant progress we have made implementing our financial plan and our current strong financial condition. We are gratified with this recognition of our achievements," said USG's Chairman and Chief Executive William Foote.
